intro: Take a moment to explore the things we have done for residents and Riverside libraries.

items.label: raised toward the new Orange Terrace Library
items.detail: A branch that did not exist before the community paid for it.

items.label: READy-Set-Go Storymobile, funded
items.detail: Books go to the neighbourhood when the neighbourhood cannot come to the library.

items.label: libraries supported across Riverside
items.detail: The Main Library and seven branches, from Arlanza to Orange Terrace.

items.label: year Literary Legacy Program
items.detail: Committed giving that lets the library plan past the current budget year.

programs.title: Story Time Kits
programs.body: Provided Story Time Kits for daycare providers, so a child's first library is sometimes the room they are already in.

programs.title: On-line homework help
programs.body: On-line homework help for Riverside students, available at the hour homework actually happens.

programs.title: Casa Blanca Family Learning Center
programs.body: Provided furnishings and artwork for the Family Learning Center, because a room people want to sit in gets used.

programs.title: Eastside computers
programs.body: Provided the computers for the Eastside library, for the households that do not have one.
